# Note

`schemas/records/note.json`

A note (docs/design/m0/08 notes): the payload of note.added/v1 and the notes projection's record. internal/authority admits it only under its event's subject (id), actor (author) and time (created_at). Notes are never edited or deleted.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [NoteID](common-defs.md#noteid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `subject` | yes | null or [TypeID](common-defs.md#typeid) |  |
| `author` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `body` | yes | [NoteBody](common-defs.md#notebody) |  |
| `created_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
